justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/CachedRandomBits.java, src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/CachedRandomBitsTest.java, and its use in src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/RandomStringUtils.java. The class is package-private, 137 lines, and contains only two fields plus one constructor and one public method (`nextBits(int)`), with Javadoc stating a single purpose: generate cached random bits for RandomStringUtils. The test file exercises only that one behavior, and the caller shows it is a focused internal helper rather than a class with multiple separable responsibilities, so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization.
